updates.text: Updated after every sync with Leaguepedia, 'at least once a week and more often during the big events'; page shows a 'last update' date of November 24, 2026.

data_sources.text: Match data from Leaguepedia (CC BY-SA 3.0); damage-to-champions and vision score for pre-scoreboard games from Oracle's Elixir (from 2014); titles and finals cross-checked against hand-made lists;

coverage.text: Terms acknowledge gaps in the data

license.text: Data licence stated for the match data: CC BY-SA 3.0 (Leaguepedia); photos only where Wikimedia Commons carries a free licence.

history.text: Earliest public web-archive capture we found
